summary_zh: 把客户端 / 服务端打崩、把玩家踢出存档、把存档写坏的所有路径，先于 release 触发出来。
summary_en: Force-trigger every path that crashes the client, kicks the player, or corrupts the save before it ships.
what_i_do_zh: 对照 mod 的高交互方块 / 物品逐一拉一遍触发矩阵：单人 × 多人 × 创造 × 生存
对每个新加 entity 的死亡 / 大爆炸 / 大体积 AOE 单独跑一次
崩溃后立即拉 latest.log + crash-reports，最小化复现路径再提交
what_i_do_en: Walk every high-interaction block/item across single × multi × creative × survival
Force-test death / large-AOE / nuke paths for every new entity
After a crash, pull latest.log + crash-reports and minimize the repro before filing
judgement_zh: 硬崩溃（闪退、服务端断连）算 S0；卡死或黑屏到要强退，也按 S0 处理。

summary_zh: 服务端记录跟客户端表现对不上的地方：状态、tick、entity 包的同步差。
summary_en: Server vs client divergence — state, tick, and entity-packet drift.
what_i_do_zh: 本地 host + 第二客户端连入，操作同一对象观察双端输出
对 mod 新增 capability / NBT，观察重登 / 跨维度 / 跨服迁移行为
多人特有 bug 一定标 mp-only，避免开发者按单人复现失败
what_i_do_en: Local host + second client; operate the same object and watch both sides
For mod-added capability / NBT, observe relog / dimension-cross / migration
Tag mp-only explicitly so the dev doesn't waste time repro-ing in single-player
judgement_zh: 导致掉线 / 黑屏 → S0；状态不同步但可恢复 → S1；纯客户端粒子 / 音效偏差 → S2。

summary_zh: 把目标 mod 与常见 mod 组合（CarryOn / Cold Sweat / Serene Seasons / ToughAsNails / Legendary Survival Overhaul / Alex 系列）组装到同一存档里跑取证。
summary_en: Compose target mod with common partners (CarryOn / Cold Sweat / Serene Seasons / ToughAsNails / LSO / Alex's series) and forensically observe interaction.
what_i_do_zh: 为每个被测 mod 设计一个 "compat 矩阵"：目标 mod × 4-6 个常见 mod
重点跑 capability 冲突、tag 替换、温度 / 季节 / 背包系统的副作用
光 Hot Bath 一个 mod 我就跑出过 6 个独立的兼容性场景
what_i_do_en: Design a compat matrix per target mod: target × 4-6 common partners
Focus on capability conflicts, tag overrides, temperature/season/inventory side-effects
Hot Bath alone surfaced 6 independent compat scenarios
judgement_zh: 出现互锁 / 数据损坏 → S0；功能在某 mod 在场时失效 → S1；纯外观叠加 → S3。

summary_zh: 右键、左键、shift+、长按、附魔冲突、buff 时长，凡是代码层该做但没做的事。
summary_en: Right-click / left-click / shift+ / long-press / enchant conflicts / buff duration — everything the code should do but doesn't.
what_i_do_zh: 为每件新物品 / 方块手抄一份交互表：单击 / 长按 / shift / 副手 / 越肩视角
附魔互斥矩阵：枚举所有可上的附魔组合，找出本应互斥却能共存的对
buff 时长全部用倒计时观察，验证文档标的时长是否实测一致
what_i_do_en: Hand-trace an interaction table per new item/block: click / long-press / shift / off-hand / over-shoulder
Enchant exclusion matrix: enumerate all combos, find pairs that should be mutually exclusive but co-exist
All buffs timed against the in-game countdown; verify documented duration matches measured
judgement_zh: 压根没实现 → S1；实现了但数值错（持续时间、冷却之类） → S2。

summary_zh: advancement 的触发条件、JSON predicate、跨存档迁移，以及新存档莫名其妙自动解锁那一类。
summary_en: Advancement trigger conditions, JSON predicates, save migration, and the new-save auto-unlock bug class.
what_i_do_zh: 新建空存档 → 立刻 /list-advancements，验证哪些被错误置为已完成
每条 advancement 按文档写的触发动作做一次，看实际触不触发
对喂食 / 击杀 / 拾取类 advancement 跑跨实体测试
what_i_do_en: Fresh world → /list-advancements immediately; flag any wrongly pre-completed
Walk every advancement's documented trigger action and confirm it fires
For feed/kill/pickup-class advancements, sweep across all eligible entities
judgement_zh: 新存档自动解锁 → S1（语义错误）；该触发不触发 → S1；触发条件偏严 / 偏松 → S2。

summary_zh: 战利品表、精准采集、时运 / 抢夺修饰，加上矿物到底掉的对不对。
summary_en: Loot tables, silk-touch, fortune/looting modifiers, ore drop correctness.
what_i_do_zh: 对所有可挖方块跑 silk-touch ON / OFF × tier 1-5 矩阵
对带颜色变体的生物（软糖鱼 / 软糖熊）跑全色击杀，验证掉落是否反映颜色
时运 / 抢夺每级各跑几十次，估个掉落分布出来
what_i_do_en: Silk-touch ON/OFF × tier 1-5 matrix for every breakable block
Color-variant entities (gummy fish / bears): kill every variant, verify drop reflects color
Fortune/looting: ≥30 samples per level to estimate drop distribution
judgement_zh: 掉落物完全错 → S1；颜色 / 数量轻微偏差 → S2；时运曲线缓 → S3。

summary_zh: JEI 对照、tag 替换、堆肥成功率、酿造副产物，再加 modpack 里常见的 tag 串味问题。
summary_en: JEI cross-check, tag substitution, compost success rate, brewing by-products, modpack-induced tag bleed.
what_i_do_zh: JEI 里列的配方一条条手摆一次，看能不能合出来、产物对不对
可堆肥物品逐一进堆肥桶，验证文档说的成功率
对常见 mod 的木 / 石 / 食物 tag 加入后，看本 mod 配方是否串味
what_i_do_en: Run every JEI-listed recipe by hand; confirm result + correct output
Drop every "compostable" item into a composter and verify the documented rate
After adding common mods' wood/stone/food tags, check the target mod's recipes for unintended substitutions
judgement_zh: 整个配方做不出来 → S1；产物错 / 数量错 → S2；JEI 显示问题 → S3。

name_zh: 生物行为 / AI 测试
summary_zh: AI 寻路、攻击 / 驯服 / 繁殖 / 死亡这套生命周期、生成条件、骑乘牵引，全部要叠 biome 和昼夜两层一起看。
summary_en: AI, pathfinding, attack/tame/breed/die lifecycle, spawn conditions, mounting/leashing, biome × time-of-day matrix.
what_i_do_zh: 新生物按生命周期顺序走：刷怪笼出生、喂食、繁殖、受击、反击、死亡
biome 矩阵：把生物逐个放到原版 / mod 新增 biome 看是否符合 spawn 规则
骑乘类专门测：站立高度、跳跃高度、跨 portal 是否丢骑乘对象
what_i_do_en: Lifecycle per entity: spawn-egg → feed → breed → take-hit → retaliate → die
Biome matrix: drop each entity in vanilla / mod-added biomes; verify spawn rules
Mountable entities: standing height, jump arc, portal-crossing behavior
judgement_zh: AI 整段不动 → S1；该攻击的不攻击、该跟随的不跟随 → S2；只是动画偏移 → S3。

summary_zh: wiki、物品描述、教程书、mcmod.cn 四边对账，看谁跟实测对不上。
summary_en: wiki / item tooltip / tutorial book / mcmod.cn vs actual behavior — three-way reconciliation.
what_i_do_zh: 教程书逐字读，出现具体数字的地方（持续时间、半径、数量）都拉去实测一遍
mcmod.cn 与 CurseForge 描述对照，标出 "文档间内部矛盾" 与 "文档与实测不符"
每条 spec-mismatch 写清楚 "应为 X，实测为 Y"
what_i_do_en: Read the in-game tutorial book line by line; every concrete number (duration/radius/count) gets measured
Cross-check mcmod.cn vs CurseForge; surface internal-doc contradictions and doc-vs-actual divergences
Every spec-mismatch entry states "expected X, observed Y"
judgement_zh: 实测值跟文档差一半以上 → S1；小幅数值偏差 → S2；只是文案错字 → S3。

summary_zh: 三种视角（第一人称 / 第三人称 / 越肩）下的动作差异，外加屏幕震动、长按动作、骑乘高度、模型穿模这些容易翻车的点。
summary_en: First-person vs third-person vs over-shoulder divergence, screen shake, long-press actions, mount-rider height, model clipping.
what_i_do_zh: 每个手持物 / 武器在三种视角下分别跑：单击 / 长按 / 持续举起
屏幕震动类机制：在文档标的半径内外各放一个观察点对照
骑乘组合：每对 "载体 × 骑手" 的位置、地形适配单独检验
what_i_do_en: Every held item / weapon under all three camera modes: click / long-press / hold-up
Screen-shake mechanics: place an observer just inside and just outside the documented radius
Mount pairs: verify position + terrain fit for every (mount × rider) combo
judgement_zh: 动作压根不播 → S1；第一/第三人称之间动作或高度偏 → S2；只是细小抖动 → S3。

summary_zh: Iris / Optifine 下 mod 的特殊渲染（粒子、发光、自定义 shader 段）是否正确。
summary_en: Iris / Optifine compatibility for mod-specific rendering — particles, glow, custom shader programs.
what_i_do_zh: 先 vanilla 拿 baseline，再开 shader 跑同一组场景对照
对发光 / 自发光 / 屏幕后处理类特效专门跑一遍 shader-on / off
每次报告附上当时用的 shader 包名 + 版本，否则开发者复现不了
what_i_do_en: vanilla → no-shader baseline → shader-on diff
Run a dedicated pass for emissive / glow / post-process effects under shader-on/off
Record shader pack name + version per session
judgement_zh: 开 shader 直接崩 → S0；该亮的不亮、该透的不透 → S2；只是色差 → S3。

summary_zh: 贴图、颜色、字体，加上 UI 排版和文字到底看不看得清。
summary_en: Textures, colors, fonts, UI layout, text legibility.
what_i_do_zh: 暗色 GUI 上的浅灰文字直接截图标 "对比度不够"
颜色变体是否真的不同，截图取色比对，不靠肉眼
中文 / 日文长文本在 GUI 中的换行 / 截断
what_i_do_en: Light-grey text on dark GUI: always flag for contrast
Color variants: don't trust eyeballs — screenshot + pixel pick
CJK long text wrapping/truncation in GUI
judgement_zh: 默认 S3；如果可读性影响游戏进行 → S2。

summary_zh: zh-cn / zh-hk / zh-tw / ja_JP 各跑一遍，盯缺键、误译、歧义文案、术语不统一。
summary_en: zh-cn / zh-hk / zh-tw / ja_JP — missing keys, mistranslation, ambiguous phrasing, inconsistent terminology.
what_i_do_zh: 每种语言下把 GUI、物品名、教程书各走一遍
术语表对照：同一概念在不同位置是否用了同一个译名
文案歧义专门标注，给出建议改法（避免开发者反复返工）
what_i_do_en: Walk GUI / item names / tutorial book under each locale
Glossary cross-check: same concept must use the same translation across surfaces
Flag ambiguous phrasing with a suggested rewrite (saves dev round-trips)
judgement_zh: 默认 S3；缺键导致 GUI 显示原 key → S2。
